Stevns is a Danish municipality included in the municipal-level quality assessments of the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) and the National Patient Registry (LPR) to benchmark local healthcare performance [^src1].

Specifically, Stevns is featured in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulation (AC) treatment among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. On page 94 of the report, Stevns is listed in a detailed data table alongside other municipalities, providing specific statistical metrics regarding stroke events, confidence intervals, and treatment rates [^src1]. As a localized data point, Stevns serves as a benchmarking unit for regional healthcare quality development within the Danish healthcare system, though no further narrative details or specific clinical outcomes are elaborated upon in the text [^src1].
